$comment: Generated from the Figma build ledger. Node IDs were returned by the Figma Plugin API; do not edit by hand.

accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.summary: Vertically stacked disclosure sections. Triggers are buttons inside headings with aria-expanded; type single or multiple; content animates height and respects reduced motion.

alert.name: Alert
alert.summary: Inline, prominent message. Uses role=alert for destructive and warning, role=status otherwise. Tinted backgrounds stay at 8% so text keeps full contrast.
figmaProperties: Variant: Default | Info | Success | Warning | Destructive

alert-dialog.name: Alert Dialog
alert-dialog.summary: Modal confirmation for consequential actions (role=alertdialog). Not dismissed by clicking outside; initial focus lands on Cancel; Escape cancels.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.summary: User or entity image with an initials fallback. The image needs alt text; the fallback is shown until it loads. ring adds the brand gradient border; AvatarGroup overlaps avatars with a background ring.

badge.name: Badge
badge.summary: Small status or metadata label. Tinted variants keep 10% fills and full-strength text so contrast holds in both themes. Render as a link with asChild when it navigates.
figmaProperties: Variant: Default | Primary | Brand | Gradient | Outline | Success | Warning | Destructive

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.summary: Shows the location in a hierarchy (nav aria-label=breadcrumb). The current page is BreadcrumbPage with aria-current=page; long trails collapse into an ellipsis menu.

button.name: Button
button.summary: Triggers an action. Use one high-emphasis button (Default, Glow or Gradient) per view; Link for inline navigation. Loading keeps the label and disables interaction.
figmaProperties: Variant: Default | Glow | Gradient | Secondary | Outline | Ghost | Destructive | Link
State: Default | Hover | Disabled | Focus | Loading

button-group.name: Button Group
button-group.summary: Joins related buttons into one control. Outer corners stay rounded; inner borders collapse. Mixed inputs and nested groups are supported in code.

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.summary: Date grid built on react-day-picker. Arrow keys move by day, Page Up/Down by month; selected days expose aria-selected and today is marked. Modes: single, multiple and range.

card.name: Card
card.summary: Container for a unit of content. surface is the default (layered gradient), glass for content over imagery, solid for dense UIs, gradient border for featured items. interactive adds hover lift.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.summary: Binary or mixed (indeterminate) choice. 18px box with a 38px pointer target.
figmaProperties: State: Unchecked | Checked | Indeterminate | Focus | Invalid | Disabled

collapsible.name: Collapsible
collapsible.summary: A single show/hide region controlled by a trigger with aria-expanded. Use Accordion for several related sections.

combobox.name: Combobox
combobox.summary: Autocomplete input with a filtered listbox (Base UI Combobox). Supports single and multiple selection with chips. The list needs an aria-label.

command.name: Command
command.summary: Searchable command menu built on cmdk (role=combobox + listbox). CommandDialog opens it in a Dialog as a ⌘K palette; groups, separators, shortcuts and an empty state are included.

container.name: Container
container.summary: Centers content with a max width and responsive side gutters (space.gutter.sm → lg). Sizes sm | md | lg | xl | full.

content-wrapper.name: Content Wrapper
content-wrapper.summary: Typography for long-form content you don't control (Markdown, CMS): headings, links, lists, quotes, code and images styled at a readable measure (size.content.prose).

context-menu.name: Context Menu
context-menu.summary: Menu opened by right-click or long-press on an area (and Shift+F10 from the keyboard). Same item anatomy as Dropdown Menu.

data-table.name: Data Table
data-table.summary: TanStack Table on top of Table: sorting, filtering, row selection, column visibility and pagination. Sort buttons announce their state; the select-all checkbox has an accessible name.

date-picker.name: Date Picker
date-picker.summary: Button that opens a Calendar in a Popover. With `name` it also submits an ISO date (yyyy-mm-dd) through a hidden input.
figmaProperties: State: Placeholder | Value | Focus | Invalid | Disabled

dialog.name: Dialog
dialog.summary: Modal window (role=dialog) over a blurred scrim. Focus is trapped and returns to the trigger; Escape and the close button dismiss. Sizes map to the overlay width tokens.

drawer.name: Drawer
drawer.summary: Draggable panel built on Vaul. Bottom drawers show a handle and can be swiped closed; prefer it to Sheet on touch-first layouts.

dropdown-menu.name: Dropdown Menu
dropdown-menu.summary: Menu opened from a button (role=menu). Supports labels, groups, checkbox and radio items, shortcuts, submenus and a destructive variant; arrow keys and typeahead move between items.

empty-state.name: Empty State
empty-state.summary: Explains why an area is empty and what to do next. Media is decorative (aria-hidden); the title and description carry the message.

feature-card.name: Feature Card
feature-card.summary: Large card for a capability or project: icon tile, display title, description and a soft accent glow (start | middle | end of the brand gradient). featured uses the larger title.

field.name: Field
field.summary: Form field layout: FieldLabel, control, FieldDescription and FieldError (role=alert, linked via aria-describedby). FieldSet + FieldLegend group related fields.

grid.name: Grid
grid.summary: Responsive CSS grid: columns collapse to one column on small screens, then 2 from sm and the full count from lg. auto fills 16rem tracks.

hover-card.name: Hover Card
hover-card.summary: Preview of linked content for sighted mouse users, shown on hover or focus. Its content is supplementary: the link itself must make sense without it.

icon-button.name: Icon Button
icon-button.summary: Square, icon-only button. The label prop is required and becomes aria-label, so an icon-only control always has an accessible name.

input.name: Input
input.summary: Single-line text field. inputSize sm | md | lg maps to the control height tokens. Invalid = aria-invalid.
figmaProperties: State: Default | Filled | Hover | Focus | Invalid | Disabled

input-group.name: Input Group
input-group.summary: A field with inline add-ons: icons, prefixes and suffixes, buttons or keyboard hints. Clicking an add-on focuses the input.
figmaProperties: Addon: Icon start | Text affixes | Button end | Keyboard hint

kbd.name: Kbd
kbd.summary: Keyboard key or shortcut (<kbd>). KbdGroup combines keys; inside a tooltip it switches to the inverted colors.

label.name: Label
label.summary: Accessible label for a control (htmlFor). Dims with peer-disabled controls.

link.name: Link
link.summary: Text link. In running text it is always underlined (WCAG 1.4.1). `external` adds the arrow icon, target=_blank and a visually hidden “, opens in a new tab”.

menubar.name: Menubar
menubar.summary: Desktop-style persistent menu bar (role=menubar). Arrow keys move between menus; menus use the shared Menu Item rows.

navigation-menu.name: Navigation Menu
navigation-menu.summary: Site navigation with flyout panels (Radix NavigationMenu). Triggers open on hover or Enter; links inside are plain anchors.

page-header.name: Page Header
page-header.summary: Top-of-page introduction: eyebrow, display title (h1 by default) with an optional gradient highlight, description and actions.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.summary: Page navigation. paginationRange() computes the visible pages and ellipses; the current page has aria-current=page.

popover.name: Popover
popover.summary: Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger. Focus moves into it on open; Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

progress.name: Progress
progress.summary: Determinate or indeterminate (value=null) progress bar. Needs an accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby. Indeterminate motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.

radio-group.name: Radio Group
radio-group.summary: One choice from a short list. Arrow keys move and select; the group needs an accessible name.

scroll-area.name: Scroll Area
scroll-area.summary: Custom-styled overflow region that keeps native scrolling and keyboard support. The viewport is focusable so keyboard users can scroll it.

section.name: Section
section.summary: Page section with vertical rhythm from the section tokens (sm → lg, growing at larger breakpoints) and scroll-margin for anchored headings.

section-heading.name: Section Heading
section-heading.summary: Eyebrow, display heading (h2 by default, configurable level) with optional gradient highlight, and a lead paragraph. Sizes lg, xl and 2xl map to the display text styles.

segmented-control.name: Segmented Control
segmented-control.summary: A compact group of navigation links where exactly one is current (aria-current=page), e.g. the language switcher. For in-page state use Toggle Group or Tabs.

select.name: Select
select.summary: Pick one option from a list (Radix Select, role=combobox + listbox). For long or searchable lists use Combobox.
figmaProperties: State: Placeholder | Value | Focus | Invalid | Disabled | Open

separator.name: Separator
separator.summary: A 1px divider in border/default. Decorative by default (role=none); set decorative={false} when it separates meaningful groups.

sheet.name: Sheet
sheet.summary: Dialog that slides in from an edge (side top | right | bottom | left). Used for filters, settings and the mobile sidebar.

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.summary: Collapsible application sidebar (offcanvas or icon rail). On mobile it renders as a Sheet; Ctrl/Cmd+B toggles; state persists in the sidebar_state cookie.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.summary: Loading placeholder, hidden from assistive technology (aria-hidden). Announce loading once on the container with aria-busy and a status message. Pulse is disabled under reduced motion.

slider.name: Slider
slider.summary: Pick a value or range by dragging or with arrow keys. Each thumb needs an accessible name (thumbLabels for ranges).

spinner.name: Spinner
spinner.summary: Indeterminate loading indicator (Lucide LoaderCircle) with role=status and a default label “Loading”. Pass label={null} when a parent already announces progress.

stack.name: Stack
stack.summary: Flex layout with token-based gaps (space.stack.xs → xl). direction column | row | responsive (column, then row from sm); align and justify map to flex alignment.

stat-card.name: Stat Card
stat-card.summary: A headline number with a label and context, on a surface card. The value uses the gradient text treatment; hover lifts the card and reveals a brand hairline.

surface.name: Surface
surface.summary: Generic styled box when Card's structure is too much: variant surface | panel | muted | none, plus radius, padding (inset tokens) and elevation.

switch.name: Switch
switch.summary: Immediate on/off setting (role=switch). Use a checkbox instead when the change applies on submit.

table.name: Table
table.summary: Semantic HTML table primitives in a horizontally scrollable wrapper. Headers use the eyebrow style; rows tint on hover and when selected (data-state=selected).

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.summary: Switch between related panels (role=tablist). Pill for navigation-like tabs, Line for dense, document-like layouts. Arrow keys move between tabs.

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.summary: Multi-line text field. Grows with content (field-sizing: content) up to its max height.

theme-toggle.name: Theme Toggle
theme-toggle.summary: Icon button that flips data-theme on <html> and persists the choice. Its accessible name says what will happen (“Switch to light theme”). Shows Sun in dark mode, Moon in light mode.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.summary: Ordered list of events on a gradient rail. The current item pulses (static under reduced motion); on large screens dates move to a left column with an oversized index.

toaster.name: Toast
toaster.summary: Transient notification rendered by Toaster (Sonner) and triggered with toast(). Announced through a polite live region; actions must also be reachable elsewhere.
figmaProperties: Type: Default | Success | Info | Warning | Error

toggle.name: Toggle
toggle.summary: A two-state button (aria-pressed). Use for a single on/off option such as a formatting or view mode.
figmaProperties: State: Off | Hover | On | Focus | Disabled

toggle-group.name: Toggle Group
toggle-group.summary: A set of toggles with single or multiple selection; arrow keys move focus (roving tabindex).

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.summary: Short supplementary label shown on hover and keyboard focus (role=tooltip). Never put essential or interactive content in a tooltip; the trigger must have its own accessible name.
